ui.common.file_actions.copy_file_path.role: file actions menu item that copies the file's path to the clipboard
ui.common.file_actions.copy_file_path.tone: verb phrase plus object, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.common.file_actions.copy_file_path.note: Copies the path, not the file. The same menu lists Open file and Open folder above it, so the three must stay distinguishable.

ui.common.file_actions.open_file.role: file actions menu item that opens the file with the operating system's default application
ui.common.file_actions.open_file.tone: verb phrase plus object, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.common.file_actions.open_file.note: Opens the file itself. Distinct from Open folder, which reveals its containing directory.

ui.common.file_actions.open_folder.role: file actions menu item that reveals the file's containing folder
ui.common.file_actions.open_folder.tone: verb phrase plus object, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.common.file_actions.open_folder.note: Opens the parent directory rather than the file. It must not share wording with Open file beyond the word Open, or the two entries read as one action twice.

ui.common.file_actions.preview.role: file actions menu item that opens the file in the in-app viewer
ui.common.file_actions.preview.tone: single noun, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.common.file_actions.preview.note: Only offered for kinds the in-app viewer can draw. It is a preview inside the app, never an OS open.

ui.common.file_actions.show_in_canvas.role: file actions menu item that opens the file in the Canvas pane
ui.common.file_actions.show_in_canvas.tone: verb phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.common.file_actions.show_in_canvas.note: Canvas is the product's own pane name and stays untranslated. Distinct from Preview, which the file's own viewer opens.
